capabilities: Collect dated tasks from across the vault
Render tasks on an interactive Gantt timeline
Reschedule tasks by dragging or resizing chart bars
Embed a per-note chart with a gantt code block
Parse plain-language, Tasks emoji, and Dataview dates
extras: The store listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a limitations section on date parsing (bare years, time-of-day ordering, relative dates re-anchoring on refresh).
problem: Obsidian tasks live scattered across notes with dates in text, so there is no single timeline view to see, reorder, or reschedule them.

relations.evidence: Understands dates written in plain language ("due next monday", "tomorrow"), Tasks-style emoji dates, and Dataview [due:: ] fields.
Tasks-style emoji dates, and Dataview [due:: ] fields.

summary: Task timeline plugin that scans dated checkboxes across the vault and renders them as an interactive, drag-to-reschedule Gantt chart.
